      "observations": [
        "All 39 owned diff lines in mimecms.cpp and the actual callback/EOF ordering were read. After successful output of a nonempty decoded buffer, the change appends CRLF unless the last byte is LF or the last two bytes are LF followed by CR. A single trailing CR still gets CRLF; empty output and failed first output do not.",
        "The added bytes go through data->output_fn into the MIME line-buffer callback. They do not rewrite the stored message, CMS input, signature bytes or the decoded_buffer itself. MimeEncrypted_parse_eof flushes its existing ibuffer before calling crypto_eof; this later output can otherwise leave a new final line pending. No decoder/runtime experiment was run.",
        "A negative append result is retained in status and follows existing PR_SetError/output_fn-clearing/error return. The callback may also be used for a synthesized plain-text header when no double newline exists; that is separate existing behavior.",
        "The new nested guards preserve buffer indexing preconditions, including decoded_bytes >= 2 before reading the prior byte. Readability suggestions would use small early-return/condition helpers without skipping the enclosing signature-status work; a return from the middle of MimeCMS_eof would change its contract. Original spacing and double blank lines differ from accepted later formatter layout, with no global rule inferred.",
